name: Nsite Directory
summary: Offline metadata-only Nsite directory and NIP-01 canonical SHA-256 event inspector with zero remote site fetching.

help.purpose: Inspect Nostr nsite event metadata, verify canonical SHA-256 event IDs, group manifest versions, and check NIP-65 relay lists without downloading remote websites.
help.start: Import a Nostr event JSON/NDJSON file, paste event JSON, or click Load synthetic fixture.
help.limitations: Performs structural and canonical SHA-256 ID checks only (does not verify BIP-340 cryptographic signatures); makes zero network requests; leaves sparse metadata classified as unknown; browser-tested only.
help.data: Loaded event JSON stays in browser localStorage on this device until cleared. Nothing is fetched or published.
